cases.name: quoted-arguments
cases.hook:
[Trigger]
Operation=Install
Operation=Upgrade
Type=Package
Target=*
[Action]
When=PreTransaction
Exec=/usr/bin/bash -c 'printf "<%s>\n" "$@" >> /trace' argv0 'two words' "" x\ y a"b"c "$literal"

cases.name: hash-in-quotes
cases.hook:
[Trigger]
Operation=Install
Operation=Upgrade
Type=Package
Target=*
[Action]
When=PreTransaction
Exec=/usr/bin/bash -c 'printf x#y >> /trace'

cases.name: exec-overridden
cases.hook:
[Trigger]
Operation=Install
Operation=Upgrade
Type=Package
Target=*
[Action]
When=PreTransaction
Exec=/missing
[Action]
Exec=/usr/bin/bash -c 'printf good >> /trace'

cases.name: needs-targets
cases.hook:
[Trigger]
Operation=Install
Operation=Upgrade
Type=Package
Target=*
[Action]
When=PreTransaction
Exec=/usr/bin/bash -c 'while IFS= read -r target; do printf "%s\n" "$target" >> /trace; done'
NeedsTargets=false

cases.name: network-allowed
cases.hook:
[Trigger]
Operation=Install
Operation=Upgrade
Type=Package
Target=*
[Action]
When=PreTransaction
Exec=/usr/bin/bash -c 'printf allowed >> /trace'
NetworkAccess=allowed

cases.name: network-invalid
cases.hook:

[Action]

Type=Package

[Action]

[Trigger]
